legend: In Barcelona, a new anti-Baq tax has been approved. This tax means that every time Baq moves using public transport, he has to pay not only the cost of going from one stop to the next at each stop but also the total cost of the journey he has already made from the origin to the current stop (defined as the sum of the "normal" costs of each transport between stops, not what Baq has actually paid).

For example, if he makes a journey of five stops (let's say A,B,C,D,E$$$A, B, C, D, E$$$) and the costs of the journeys between stops are AB=1,BC=2,CD=1,DE=3$$$AB = 1, BC = 2, CD = 1, DE = 3$$$, then the total cost for Baq will be 15$$$15$$$: at A$$$A$$$ he will pay 1$$$1$$$ to go to B$$$B$$$; at B$$$B$$$ he will pay 2$$$2$$$ to go to C$$$C$$$ plus 1$$$1$$$, which is the cost of the journey AB$$$AB$$$; at C$$$C$$$ he will pay 1$$$1$$$ to go to D$$$D$$$ plus 3$$$3$$$, which is the cost of the journey ABC$$$ABC$$$ (1+2$$$1+2$$$); at D$$$D$$$ he will pay 3$$$3$$$ to go to E$$$E$$$ plus 4$$$4$$$, which is the cost of the journey ABCD$$$ABCD$$$ (1+2+1$$$1+2+1$$$).
Baq does not like this tax, but he will not give up the transport service. Baq asks you to help him find the minimum cost of a journey between stop 0$$$0$$$ and each of the other n−1$$$n-1$$$ stops.
input: The input starts with an integer T$$$T$$$, the number of cases. Each case begins with two integers n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$, the number of stops and the number of connections between stops. This is followed by m$$$m$$$ lines with three integers ui,vi,wi$$$u_i, v_i, w_i$$$, indicating that there is a connection from stop ui$$$u_i$$$ to stop vi$$$v_i$$$ with a price of wi$$$w_i$$$. The stops are numbered from 0$$$0$$$ to n−1$$$n-1$$$. The connections between stops are directed, meaning that the connection from u$$$u$$$ to v$$$v$$$ is not the same as the connection from v$$$v$$$ to u$$$u$$$.
output: For each case, write on a line with n−1$$$n-1$$$ integers, the i$$$i$$$-th (starting from 1$$$1$$$) of which is the cost for Baq of the journey between station 0$$$0$$$ and station i$$$i$$$. If he cannot reach station i$$$i$$$, write −1$$$-1$$$.
3≤n,m≤1000$$$3 \leq n, m \leq 1000$$$. The sum of n+m$$$n+m$$$ for all cases is less than 3⋅104$$$3 \cdot 10^4$$$.
22 points: n≤10,m≤20$$$n \leq 10, m \leq 20$$$, the sum of n+m$$$n+m$$$ for all cases is less than 800$$$800$$$.

14 points: Each stop is only connected to the previous and the next (cyclically). Formally, m=2n$$$m = 2n$$$ and u2i=u2i−1=i−1,v2i=i−2,v2i−1=i$$$u_{2i} = u_{2i-1} = i-1, v_{2i} = i-2, v_{2i-1} = i$$$ for all i$$$i$$$ except edges 2$$$2$$$ and 2n−1$$$2n-1$$$, which are u2=0,v2=n−1$$$u_2 = 0, v_2 = n-1$$$ and u2n−1=n−1,v2n−1=0$$$u_{2n-1} = n-1, v_{2n-1} = 0$$$.
29 points: n,m≤80$$$n, m \leq 80$$$, the sum of n+m$$$n+m$$$ for all cases is less than 2500$$$2500$$$.

legend.ai: 在巴塞罗那，一项新的反 Baq 税获批。这项税收意味着，每当 Baq 使用公共交通出行时，他在每一站不仅要支付从当前站前往下一站的费用，还要支付他已经从起点到达当前站的整个行程的总费用（该费用定义为各段站点之间交通的“正常”费用之和，而不是 Baq 实际支付的费用）。

例如，假设他要经过五个站点(设为 A、B、C、D、E$$$A, B, C, D, E$$$)，且站点之间各段行程的费用为 AB=1、BC=2、CD=1、DE=3$$$AB = 1, BC = 2, CD = 1, DE = 3$$$，那么 Baq 总共需要支付 15$$$15$$$：在 A$$$A$$$，他将支付 1$$$1$$$ 前往 B$$$B$$$；在 B$$$B$$$，他将支付 2$$$2$$$ 前往 C$$$C$$$，另外还要支付 1$$$1$$$，这就是行程 AB$$$AB$$$ 的费用；在 C$$$C$$$，他将支付 1$$$1$$$ 前往 D$$$D$$$，另外还要支付 3$$$3$$$，这就是行程 ABC$$$ABC$$$ 的费用(1+2$$$1+2$$$)；在 D$$$D$$$，他将支付 3$$$3$$$ 前往 E$$$E$$$，另外还要支付 4$$$4$$$，这就是行程 ABCD$$$ABCD$$$ 的费用(1+2+1$$$1+2+1$$$)。
Baq 不喜欢这项税费，但他不会放弃运输服务。Baq 请你帮助他求出从站点 0$$$0$$$ 到其余 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 个站点中每一站的最小行程费用。

input.ai: 输入以整数 T$$$T$$$ 开头，表示测试用例数。每个用例以两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 m$$$m$$$ 开头，分别表示站点数和站点之间的连接数。接下来有 m$$$m$$$ 行，每行包含三个整数 ui,vi,wi$$$u_i, v_i, w_i$$$，表示存在一条从站点 ui$$$u_i$$$ 到站点 vi$$$v_i$$$ 的连接，价格为 wi$$$w_i$$$。站点编号为 0$$$0$$$ 到 n−1$$$n-1$$$。站点之间的连接是有向的，即从 u$$$u$$$ 到 v$$$v$$$ 的连接与从 v$$$v$$$ 到 u$$$u$$$ 的连接不相同。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 个整数，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 个(从 1$$$1$$$ 开始编号)是 Baq 从站点 0$$$0$$$ 到站点 i$$$i$$$ 的行程费用。如果他无法到达站点 i$$$i$$$，则输出 −1$$$-1$$$。
